svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: where did Sand study? Game and simulation programming at DeVry University (2010 to 2013), after computer science at Miami Dade College (2008 to 2010). Q: what else is on the workbench? godotion (GDScript, 1 star): A motion-graphics timeline editor plugin for Godot 4. Scene nodes become tracks, drawn with Godot's own editor icons and theme. Q: any GitHub stats? 1,440 contributions, 6 mo, 101 active days, 18 days, best streak, 142 on the busiest day This week so far: 24 contributions and 0 pull request events. Q: what's Sand building right now? Latest: Grow the agent chat from Sand's resume in TheSandemon (#7, merged, Sep 25). The plan, straight from the PR: Open to work is pinned right after the intro.
